title: The lab and clerk are experimental works; build reusable, modular understanding (2026-11-10)

sections.name: narrative
sections.content: The lab and clerk have all emerged as experimental works. We should always be working to build reusable, modular understanding

sections.name: source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-10, rejecting a plan draft that proposed extracting the clerk's and srs-lab's tension rules (domainField, judgement) into a shared JS package for srs-web; recorded verbatim.
